name: 5'-end purine… to S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine
summary: A 8-step route from 5'-end purine ribonucleotide 5'-triphosphate(4−) residue to S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine zwitterion, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.equation: a 5'-end triphospho-(purine-ribonucleoside) in mRNA + H2O = a 5'-end diphospho-(purine-ribonucleoside) in mRNA + phosphate + H(+)

reactions.name: a 5'-end diphospho-(purine-ribonucleoside) in mRNA + GTP + H(+) = a 5'-end (5'-triphosp...
reactions.equation: a 5'-end diphospho-(purine-ribonucleoside) in mRNA + GTP + H(+) = a 5'-end (5'-triphosphoguanosine)-(purine-ribonucleoside) in mRNA + diphosphate

reactions.name: a 5'-end (5'-triphosphoguanosine)-(purine-ribonucleoside) in mRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methio...
reactions.equation: a 5'-end (5'-triphosphoguanosine)-(purine-ribonucleoside) in mRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a 5'-end (N(7)-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-(purine-ribonucleoside) in mRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine

reactions.name: a 5'-end (N(7)-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-(purine-ribonucleoside) in mRNA + S-adeno...
reactions.equation: a 5'-end (N(7)-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-(purine-ribonucleoside) in mRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a 5'-end (N(7)-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-(2'-O-methyl-purine-ribonucleoside) in mRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: a 5'-end (N(2),N(2),N(7)-trimethyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-purine ribonucleoside in mRN...
reactions.equation: a 5'-end (N(2),N(2),N(7)-trimethyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-purine ribonucleoside in mRNA + H2O = (N(2),N(2),N(7))-trimethyl-GMP + a 5'-end diphospho-(purine-ribonucleoside) in mRNA + 2 H(+)

reactions.equation: a 5'-end (N(7)-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-(purine-ribonucleoside) in mRNA + H2O = a 5'-end phospho (purine-ribonucleoside) in mRNA + N(7)-methyl-GDP + 2 H(+)

reactions.name: tRNA (adenine-N(6)-)-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: an adenosine in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = an N(6)-methyladenosine in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: site-specific DNA-methyltransferase (cytosine-N(4)-specific)
reactions.equation: a 2'-deoxycytidine in DNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = an N(4)-methyl-2'-deoxycytidine in DNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: methylenetetrahydrofolate--tRNA-(uracil(54)-C(5))-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: uridine(54) in tRNA + (6R)-5,10-methylene-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + NADPH + H(+) = 5-methyluridine(54) in tRNA + (6S)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + NADP(+)

reactions.name: assimilatory dimethylsulfide S-monooxygenase
reactions.equation: dimethyl sulfide + NADH + O2 + H(+) = dimethyl sulfoxide + NAD(+) + H2O

reactions.name: dimethyl sulfide + AH2 = methane + methanethiol + A
reactions.equation: dimethyl sulfide + AH2 = methane + methanethiol + A

reactions.name: phenylalanine--tRNA ligase
reactions.equation: tRNA(Phe) + L-phenylalanine + ATP = L-phenylalanyl-tRNA(Phe) + AMP + diphosphate + H(+)

reactions.name: tRNA (N(6)-L-threonylcarbamoyladenosine(37)-C(2))-methylthiotransferase
reactions.equation: N(6)-L-threonylcarbamoyladenosine(37) in tRNA + (sulfur carrier)-SH + AH2 + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2-methylsulfanyl-N(6)-L-threonylcarbamoyladenosine(37) in tRNA + (sulfur carrier)-H + 5'-deoxyadenosine + L-methionine + A + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + 2 H(+)
